method: Current institutional listing and visual read of image-only one-page protocol flyers (Web PDF screenshot, p. 1).
roster_result: Both exact named protocols are listed in Current Trials; no dated cutoff or slots published. Dallas VROC is the only named institution in each exact flyer.

utsw-vroc-melanoma-carboplatin-hifu.facts: Confirmed canine melanoma with a target accessible to injection and/or ultrasound, older than six months, no prior chemotherapy or immunotherapy for melanoma; uncontrolled comorbidity or anesthetic risk excludes. IV or intratumoral carboplatin with or without HIFU, every three weeks for three to four cycles; at least three months of follow-up. Owner pays; possible subsidies only.
utsw-vroc-melanoma-carboplatin-hifu.contact: Paige Neumann, Research Study Coordinator — 214-645-6221; VROC@UTSouthwestern.edu

utsw-vroc-compassionate-advanced-unresec.facts: Study objective and patient description say canine. Confirmed advanced/inoperable or recurrent tumor not covered by another VROC study; older than six months, above 2.5 kg, expected survival over three weeks, adequate organ function, and owner declines surgery or standard care. Individual protocol chosen by clinical team and board; at least one month of follow-up. Owner pays; possible subsidies only. Generic heading/index mentions cats; does not establish feline eligibility.
utsw-vroc-compassionate-advanced-unresec.contact: Paige Neumann, Research Study Coordinator — 214-645-6221; VROC@UTSouthwestern.edu
